context: Kenji and Ren brainstorm a product idea.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech brainstorming; vocabulary (アイデア/つながり/発達/細かい/開く) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しいアイデアを、思いついたんです。
lines.en: I came up with a new idea.
lines.style: excited young colleague voice, soft warm eager throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: どんなアイデアですか?聞かせて下さい。
lines.en: What kind of idea? Tell me.
lines.style: engaged office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人と人の、つながりを作る道具です。
lines.en: A tool to create connections between people.
lines.style: enthusiastic young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 技術の発達で、実現できそうですね。
lines.en: With technological development, it seems feasible.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 細かい設計は、これから詰めます。
lines.en: I'll work out the fine design from here.
lines.style: focused young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 細かい点も、一緒に開いていきましょう。
lines.en: Let's open up the fine points together.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: つながりが、もっと広がるといいな。
lines.en: I hope the connections spread more.
lines.style: hopeful young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいアイデアは、未来を開きますよ。
lines.en: A good idea opens the future.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
